ios.desc:
The only grocery list app that lets you browse ANY store and add items with real prices. Shop Walmart, Target, ALDI, Costco, Publix, Harris Teeter, Trader Joe's, and any other grocery store — all from one app. Track your budget, share lists, and never overspend again.

SHOP ANY GROCERY STORE IN THE APP

- Browse Walmart, Target, ALDI, Costco, Publix, Harris Teeter, and more
- Not limited to a set list — navigate to ANY grocery store you shop at
- Add items to your list with one tap and see real prices instantly
- Save your favorite stores for quick access every time

REAL PRICES AS YOU SHOP

- See live pricing from every store you browse
- Know exactly what you'll spend before leaving home
- No guessing, no surprises at checkout
- Works with any grocery store website

SMART BUDGET TRACKING

- Set a spending limit for any shopping trip
- Watch your running total update as you add items
- Stay on track with visual budget progress
- Get alerts before you exceed your budget

SHARED GROCERY LISTS

- Share lists with family, roommates, or partners
- Real-time updates when anyone adds or removes items
- See who added what and track shared spending
- Perfect coordination for busy households

SAVE YOUR FAVORITE STORES

- Bookmark the stores you shop at most
- Create custom stores with personalized icons
- Quick-launch into any saved store in one tap
- Your stores, your way

ORGANIZED SHOPPING

- Items automatically categorized for aisle-by-aisle shopping
- Shopping mode to check off items while in-store
- Switch between multiple lists while browsing stores
- Smart reminders to keep your list fresh

PERFECT FOR

- Solo shoppers who want to stick to a budget
- Families managing grocery budgets together
- Anyone who shops at multiple stores for best deals
- Roommates splitting shopping costs
- Couples planning meals and tracking expenses
- Budget-conscious shoppers who want real price visibility

SAVE TIME & MONEY

- Sign in instantly with Google or Apple — no setup hassle
- Browse any store without switching apps
- Stick to your budget with real-time price tracking
- Eliminate overspending with live totals
- Reduce food waste through better planning
- Transform your grocery shopping with the only app that lets you browse any grocery store, add items with real prices in one tap, and track your budget — all in one place. Works with Walmart, Target, ALDI, Costco, Publix, Harris Teeter, Sam's Club, Food Lion, Lidl, Trader Joe's, Whole Foods, and any store you shop at.

quotes.text:
I built Plateful for a few personal reasons:

Me and my wife had a recurring problem, we would set a budget for our groceries (we shop every two weeks) but we kept overspending. This would happen because we planned our own meals but followed the same budget without any coordination.

When I was meal planning my meals, I was jumping from different stores looking for the best macros and prices. I had a notepad and was writing it all down that way. I decided to try and make an app for it to make our lives easier.

The cycle was annoying - going over budget pretty much everytime.

Plateful solves these problems with:

Real-time shared grocery lists so both partners instantly see updates, even while one is at the store

Collaborative meal planning with a calendar view showing what meals are planned for the week

Store price comparison across major chains like Walmart, Target, Aldi, and more

Budget tracking that lets you set limits and see exactly where you stand

Barcode scanning to quickly add items you're running low on

Nutrition tracking for those watching macros or calories

For us, the greatest help was being able to add ingredients/items from the stores we shop at into the same grocery list. The prices are added to the shared grocery list with the macros (if available).

Since we started using it, we have been able to stick to our budget and macros much easier!
